schema: slug, name, description, type, status, tags, related, path, updated -- mirrored from file frontmatter. index.json is the fast-load catalog; open individual files only when needed.

davey-profile.name: Davey - Profile and Values
davey-profile.description: Who Davey is: background, expertise, core values, and work style. Primary context for tailoring all responses.

davey-collaboration-preferences.name: Davey Collaboration Preferences
davey-collaboration-preferences.description: Preserve interrupted work, track finished vs unfinished tasks, keep implementation off main checkouts.

ascii-only.name: ASCII-only in all files
ascii-only.description: Never use non-ASCII characters in any file output -- no emoji, no Unicode dashes or arrows.

right-over-immediate.name: Right solution over immediate solution
right-over-immediate.description: Always choose the architecturally correct approach; never build scaffolding then offer to upgrade it.

attention-to-detail.name: Attention to detail
attention-to-detail.description: Read requirements carefully, verify configurations exactly, announce each action before doing it.

verbose-script-logging.name: Verbose script logging
verbose-script-logging.description: Long-running scripts must emit timestamped progress to stdout AND a log file.

no-find-grep-cat.name: Never use find/grep/cat via Bash
no-find-grep-cat.description: Always use dedicated tools (Glob/Grep/Read/Edit); never reach for find/grep/cat/head/tail/sed/awk in Bash.

oo-containerization.name: OO containerization -- entities own data AND behavior
oo-containerization.description: Domain entities own their data AND the methods that operate on it; no parallel dicts keyed by identity tuples.

snake-case.name: snake_case everywhere
snake-case.description: All identifiers including class names use snake_case; overrides Python PEP8 PascalCase convention.

no-ssh.name: No SSH by default
no-ssh.description: Do not initiate SSH or remote commands by default; a direct instruction overrides this for that task only.

git-no-claude.name: No Claude attribution in git commits
git-no-claude.description: Omit Co-Authored-By Claude footer from all commit messages.

tool-permissions.name: Tool use pre-approved
tool-permissions.description: All tool use is pre-approved; call tools directly without asking for permission first.

csc-chain-integration.name: CSC chain integration required
csc-chain-integration.description: New CSC classes must integrate into the inheritance chain via server reference, not float as standalone objects.

es-for-search.name: Use es (Everything CLI) for file searches
es-for-search.description: Prefer the es command for locating files by name; install CLI tools to ~/.local/bin/ exactly as directed.

proactive-tool-usage.name: Use memory, code maps, and agents proactively
proactive-tool-usage.description: Check memory at session start, use code maps as source of truth, save learnings immediately -- do not force Davey to repeat context.

news-scholarly-sources.name: Prefer news and scholarly sources over Wikipedia
news-scholarly-sources.description: For current events and tracked topics, cite news, scholarly/think-tank work, and official briefings -- not Wikipedia or Britannica.

margaret-weak-reviewer.name: Margaret Bridges peer review is weak
margaret-weak-reviewer.description: ENGL 1302 peer reviewer Margaret Bridges provides inaccurate feedback; weight below Prof. Royall's.
